concept: EFS: shared POSIX (NFS) file share for Linux across AZs
tests: Choosing shared file storage for a Linux cluster across multiple AZs with auto-scaling and POSIX.
expected: Amazon EFS — managed NFS, grows elastically, POSIX, concurrent access from many EC2 instances in different AZs. Triggers: "shared file storage", "Linux", "multiple AZs", "POSIX", "scale automatically".
why_not: EBS Multi-Attach — single AZ and few instances only; FSx for Windows — SMB for Windows; S3 — object storage, not POSIX.
